bq24.notes: From Ange's sector map: fire risk either side of the afternoon summer sun, west to north-west. The block is Bush Fire Prone Land (vegetation buffer) and the house is built to BAL 29.

bq25.name: Cool and cold wind (south to south-east)
bq25.notes: From Ange's sector map: the cool and cold winds come from the south to south-east (answer 22). A screen or hedge on that side shelters the vegie beds and the herb strip.

bq26.notes: From Ange's sector map: the view worth keeping open is to the north-east.

bq27.name: Summer sun
bq27.notes: From Ange's sector map: summer sun arcs from the east-south-east in the morning to the west-north-west in the afternoon; the computed arc is shown.
